definitions.short: properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i.e. an idolatrous priest (only in plural)
definitions.full: H3649. komer [ כֹּ֫מֶר ] noun masculine (idol-)priest (so Late Hebrew כּוּמָר ; Aramaic , כּוּמְרָא , is also priest of God; Nerab כמר Hal Rev. Semitic 1896, 280, 282 ; Nabataean כמר priest CIS ii, No. 170, Teima כמרא id. CIS ii, No. 113 a, b, b bis ; so כמר Neo-Punic Eut ZMG. 1875, 238, 239 Berger JAs Apr.-June, 1887, 465 ; perhaps Tel Amarna kamiru Bez BM.:Tabl, xxvi; Or. Dipl. 92 ; Wkl TA. 1, 15, 33 leaves untranslated ); — plural absolute, in O.T. only of idol-priests; הַכְּמָרִים 2Kin 23:5 , כְּמָרָיו Hosea 10:5 , ׳הַכּ עִםהַֿכֹּהֲנִים Zeph 1:4 . In Hosea 4:4 Beck (in Wü 142 ) We proposes כִּכְמָרָיו וְעַמִּי (for כִּמְרִיבֵי וְעַמְּךָ ᵑ0 ). כמת (√ of following, meaning unknown).
